tsp cake batter extract  tangzhong 3 cups bread flour (360g), plus up to ½ cup (60g) as needed 2 tbsp milk powder (15g) ¾ tsp salt (4g) mix the warm milk, sugar, and yeast together and let sit for about 5 minutes until foamy. add the melted butter, egg, egg yolk, and tangzhong. mix until combined. add the milk powder and salt, then gradually add the flour. start with 3 cups and add more as needed until you have a soft, smooth dough. i ended up using about 3½ cups total. if kneading by hand, try not to add too much extra flour. lightly oil your hands and work surface if needed. place in ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150g) 1 tsp cinnamon  ¼ tsp salt cream together the softened butter and sugar until fluffy. mix in the egg, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. gradually add the flour and and salt until a soft cookie dough forms. assembling the rolls: once the cinnamon roll dough has doubled in size, roll it out into a rectangle, keeping it about ¾ inch thick. spread the sugar cookie dough evenly over the surface. sprinkle Christmas nonpareils over the sugar cookie layer. cut the dough into approximately 12 strips, then roll each strip individually. arrange the rolls in a lined baking dish. cover and let rise again for about 25–35 minutes, until slightly puffier. don’t let them overproof. before baking: heavy cream, for brushing lightly brush the tops of the rolls with heavy cream before baking. bake at 350°F for about 25–30 minutes, or until cooked through. baking time may vary depending on your oven. if almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1–2 tbsp heavy cream, as needed whip the butter and cream cheese until fluffy. add the powdered sugar, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. mix Garlic Butter Spaghetti 🔥 Quick, easy, and dangerously good. Buttery garlic heaven with a hint of spice… Pro Tip: Level it up with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -2 shallots, thinly sliced -5 garlic cloves, minced -2 tbsp chili crisp -1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature -1 tbsp soy sauce, optional -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -2 tbsp butter -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, oregano 1. Slice your shallots nice and thin and measure out your seasonings. Bring your cream or coconut milk to room temp so it blends in smoothly later. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add the shallots and sauté for 8–10 minutes until soft and starting to turn golden. 3. While the shallots are doing their thing, bring a big pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Drain, but save some pasta water… it’s liquid gold. Seriously, don’t you dare dump it. Italians everywhere are watching. 4. Once the shallots are soft and sweet, stir in your minced garlic (fresh garlic only - if you pull out that jarred stuff, the FBI will be at your door in minutes 😅) and all the seasonings. Let them bloom for about a minute, then add the chili crisp and give it another quick sauté. 5. Pour in the cream (or coconut milk), stir in the soy sauce if using, and let it simmer for a few minutes to thicken. Add in the grated Parmesan and stir. 6. Toss your pasta in the sauce until fully coated, adding splashes of reserved pasta water as needed to get that perfect silky consistency. 7. Serve hot with an extra spoonful of chili crisp on top for a little heat and a sprinkle of Parmesan and parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy. #dinnerideas #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #pasta

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Blanket Dumplings 🥟 These dumplings definitely live up to the hype. They’re by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. 🥩🍲 Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Beef & Onion Gravy This tender, juicy slow-cooked beef is the ultimate comfort food! Thick, beautifully browned pieces of beef simmer low and slow in a rich, savory garlic butter gravy with sweet caramelized onions. Every piece is coated in a delicious, glossy sauce that makes this dish absolutely irresistible. The slow cooking process allows the beef to soak up all those incredible flavors until it's fork-tender and incredibly juicy. It's the kind of hearty, homemade dinner that fills the kitchen with an amazing aroma and brings everyone to the table. ❤️ 🥘 Ingredients 2 lbs beef chuck steak or boneless beef roast, sliced into thick pieces 2 large onions, sliced 4 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp butter 2 cups beef broth 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp tomato paste 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper Salt to taste 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water (optional) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Season the beef with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet with a little oil and sear the beef on both sides until nicely browned. Place sliced onions and minced garlic in the slow cooker. Arrange the browned beef over the onions. Mix beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and tomato paste. Pour over the beef. Add butter on top, cover, and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours or HIGH for 4–5 hours, until fork-tender. If desired, thicken the gravy with the cornstarch mixture during the final 20–30 minutes. Spoon that rich, flavorful onion gravy over the beef and serve hot! 😍 Perfect with creamy mashed potatoes, buttery rice, or warm dinner rolls to soak up every drop of that delicious gravy! ✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Classic Patty Melt Recipe Ingredients 1 lb 450 g ground beef (80/20 for best flavor) 4 slices rye bread 4 slices Swiss cheese 1 medium onion thinly sliced 2 tablespoons butter plus more for bread ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon oil Instructions Caramelize the onions Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring often, until soft, golden, and sweet (about 8–10 minutes). Remove from pan and set aside. Form the patties Divide beef into 2 thin oval patties shaped to match bread size. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook the burgers In the same skillet, cook patties over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Assemble the melts Butter one side of each bread slice. On the unbuttered side, layer: Swiss cheese Beef patty Caramelized onions Another slice of Swiss cheese Top with another slice of bread (buttered side facing out). Grill to perfection Place sandwiches in the skillet over medium heat. Cook 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until bread is golden and cheese is fully melted. Serve Slice in half and serve hot with fries, chips, or pickles.
